content.text:
I submitted **index 7 (In 0.80 / Sb 0.20)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.429%, the highest of the three compositions I could measure.

| Index | In : Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0.87 : 0.13 | 0.115 |
| 7 | 0.80 : 0.20 | **0.429** |
| 20 | 0.39 : 0.61 | 0.031 |

- **Budget:** I used all 3 EQE measurements, plus 3 of the 5 XRD measurements (indices 0, 7 and 11).
- **Structure:** The XRD shows two phases. The In-rich film (index 0) is mostly an In₂O₃-type (bixbyite) phase. A second phase, with peaks at Q ≈ 2.79, 4.55 and 5.33 Å⁻¹, grows as Sb increases and is the strongest peak by index 11. Index 7 contains both.
- **Where the best likely is:** EQE fell off both toward the In-rich end and toward the Sb-rich end. The peak is probably in the In-rich two-phase region, near the known In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄ compound (In ≈ 0.79).
- **Uncertainty:** Three measurements across 30 compositions is sparse, so the true best could be a neighbour of index 7 that I never measured (for example indices 5–10). Unmeasured compositions earn nothing, so index 7 is the answer I can stand behind. The model's top suggestion, index 11, went unmeasured when the budget ran out.
